title: AIRWA — Price Manipulation via Unauthorized Burn Rate Modification
root_cause: No access control on `setBurnRate()`, allowing anyone to set the burn rate to 100%
code_after:
✅ Access control
        require(_burnRate <= MAX_BURN_RATE, "Burn rate too high"); //
steps: ► ❌ No access control → burn rate set to 100%
[2] ► Buy small amount of AIRWA tokens (BNB → AIRWA)
► Transfer on purchase → 100% burned → LP pool reserve decreases
